definition: Nature Machine Intelligence is a monthly peer-reviewed scientific journal published by Nature Portfolio covering machine learning and artificial intelligence.

explainer.lead: Nature Machine Intelligence is a monthly peer-reviewed journal from Nature Portfolio covering machine learning and artificial intelligence. It matters as a venue where AI research is formally reviewed and published.

tiers.eli5: It's a science magazine, like a very serious monthly journal, where AI researchers publish their work after other experts check it.
tiers.practitioner: Researchers cite it as a peer-reviewed outlet when publishing or reading AI work. A pitfall is treating a single paper there as settled consensus rather than one reviewed contribution.
tiers.paperLevel: It is a monthly peer-reviewed scientific journal published by Nature Portfolio covering machine learning and artificial intelligence; the editor-in-chief is Liesbeth Venema.

explainer.example: A lab submits a machine learning paper, it passes peer review, and it appears in a monthly issue of the journal.
